name: Replo
description: Replo is an AI agent and site builder for ecommerce brands to build storefronts, landing pages and funnels, manage products, orders and scheduled tasks.

events.d: Create a product in a Replo project with title, description, slug and checkout link.
Update a product title, description, slug, status or checkout link.
List all products in a project, search them by text, or get one by ID.
List orders in a project filtered by payment status or customer email, or get one by ID.
Schedule a prompt for Replo to run on a one-off or recurring basis, with optional email results.
Update a scheduled task prompt, title, repeat rule or email delivery.
Send a prompt to the Replo agent in a project to start new work.
Send a follow-up prompt to an existing Replo agent session.
Get the status, latest reply and pending questions of a Replo agent session.
Publish a Replo site so the latest changes go live.
Runs when a new order is placed in a chosen project, optionally filtered by payment status.

recipes.ae: List a record by Record ID
